jobs_results.title: Game Designer
jobs_results.description:
CrazyLabs, a world-leading mobile game developer with over 6 Billion downloads to date, is looking for a creative, motivated, and enthusiastic Game Designer to join our team and work on our next Hyper and Hybrid Simulation games.

What you’ll be working on
• Collaborate with the Ideation and Game Product Owners team to create new game ideas as well as working on existing games in the pipeline.
• Review and analyze game design features as well as suggest solutions according to specific KPIs and business challenges.
• In charge of creation of design briefs, flowcharts, and feature layouts.
• Participate in playtesting sessions, gathering and analyzing feedback to iterate on and improve game performance, features and mechanics
• Work closely with the game product owners to define requirements and roadmap.
• Work with the external and internal teams - mentor them to successfully develop and deliver high profile games
• Continuously research and keep up to date with industry trends, best... practices, and emerging game design techniques and technologies.
• Help come up with new & engaging game themes and mechanics

What we’re looking for
• At least 3 year of game design experience in a mobile gaming company
• Bachelor's degree in Game Design, Interactive Media, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience
• Strong knowledge of game design principles, including mechanics, storytelling, and level design.
• UI/UX experience - An advantage
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex ideas clearly and concisely.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and creatively.
• Unity and Adobe Photoshop - an advantage
• Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team, time management and prioritization
• Passion for gaming and especially to the Hyper and Hybrid Simulation world as well as deep understanding of what makes games fun and engaging.

What we offer
• Join a supportive and creative team of professionals
• Make an impact - shape our next hit mobile game, reaching millions of end-users!
• Personal growth - we encourage continuous learning and experimentation within our international teams
• Fun and Flexible work environment, team events, and more

jobs_results.title: Senior Game Developer - Casual Games
jobs_results.description:
Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps. With 7 billion downloads and over 150 million monthly active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta.

The company is one of the most impressive examples of hypergrowth in the ecosystem, having raised over $1B and backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent, and GBL.

Voodoo is now a team of over 750 employees worldwide, we’re looking for talented individuals from across the globe to come and entertain the world with us.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual, and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing, and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

Joining our Live games team means collaborating with gaming industry experts on globally renowned, enduring games while embracing exciting new... entrepreneurial ventures. With over seven billion downloads worldwide and a portfolio of more than 10 resilient hybrid games generating more than $20m per year, we are the largest and most successful hybrid publisher in the world.

Voodoo is creating a small experimentation team with a big mission: find the next best way to entertain the world by taking our best hits to a new level.

You will be one of the first members of a team of six and you will participate in every aspect of development, from ideation to testing the casual games in the market.

The 'Live' games team is working on hybrid-casual games like:

Mob Control

Collect Em All

Uboat Attack

Bubble Fall

Block Jam 3D

Role

We are looking for a talented Game Developer with a good understanding of the casual mobile game market to help the team deliver fun, innovative, and entertaining games. You will take an innovative approach to gameplay ideas/features and give them their own spin.
• Create innovative hit games
• Write robust code to be used by millions of users
• Ability to deconstruct, analyze and adapt mobile games mechanics
• Support and contribute new ideas to game features

With this role, you will have a strong impact on the company by contributing daily to important decisions with a senior, multidisciplinary team of passionate and talented people. Flesh out the details of a game's design, oversee its testing, and revise the game in response to player feedback. Thanks to your creativity and your teamwork, let’s entertain millions of people with your hit games.

Profile
• A creative and hacker mindset
• At least 5 years of professional experience on Unity or other game engines
• Good sense of gameplay experience and special attention to details
• Familiar with optimization issues
• Speak and write English
• Track record with successful mobile games
• Professional game development experience

Benefits: competitive salary and other benefits according to the country you reside

jobs_results.title: Unreal developer
jobs_results.description:
Seleccionamos un Desarrollador de Videojuegos de Unreal con talento y creativo para trabajar al más alto nivel. Será responsable de implementar la funcionalidad del juego, traduciendo ideas de diseño, conceptos y requisitos a un juego funcional y atractivo.

Nuestro candidato ideal debe tener entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en tecnologías de desarrollo en Unreal, sólidas habilidades de programación y codificación, buen ojo para los detalles y habilidades analíticas para identificar problemas potenciales con un plan de diseño. Trabajando en muchos departamentos diferentes, este puesto requiere un candidato con excelentes habilidades de comunicación, una actitud proactiva y una buena ética de equipo para unificar una visión común.

- Meeting with the design team to discuss gaming ideas and specifications.
- Establishing strategy and development pipelines.
- Planning and implementing game functionality.
- Transforming design ideas into functional games.
- Designing and building game... codes.
- Identifying and fixing code errors and game bottlenecks.
- Testing game functionality and theme dynamics.
- Ensuring products conform to high industry standards.
- Designing and building game patches and upgrades.

Requisitos minimos:

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a similar field.
- Previous experience working as a Unreal developer.
- In-depth knowledge of Unreal software.
- Knowledge of 3D development and integrated game physics.
- Experience with console and mobile game development.
- Good communication skills.
- Experience with memory and space optimization.
- Knowledge of scripting, animation, session management, and textures.
- Good troubleshooting skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.

Se ofrece:

- Teletrabajo 100%
- Contratación Indefinida con periodo de prueba.
- Incorporación a empresa con productos punteros en el sector y en plena expansión de su actividad y gama.
- Retribución: Entre 30.000 y 40.000 Euros b/a, según experiencia y valía aportadas

jobs_results.title: Programador Unreal Engine
jobs_results.description:
Somos una empresa de que ofrece soluciones visuales para el sector biotecnológico y pharma.

Entre nuestros servicios destacan la animación 3D e ilustración científica.

El equipo está compuesto en esencia por científicos y artistas gráficos.

Buscamos un desarrollador para que se incorpore a nuestro equipo en su nuevo departamento de I+D con Unreal.

CAPACIDADES:

• Experiencia en programación en C++, Python o Blueprints, en Unreal Engine.

• Más de 5 años de experiencia en experiencias interactivas.

• Desarrollo de mecánicas de juego, importación de elementos y optimización de escenas en Unreal Engine para la creación de entornos Artísticos enfocados a experiencias VR.

• Experiencia en optimización/rendimiento vs la calidad artística.

• Experiencia en valorar optimizaciones de rendimiento vs la calidad artística.

• Responsable en la comunicación entre programación y arte para que la arquitectura del proyecto tenga la base más optima.

• Experiencia en desarrollo de juegos... móviles 3D.

• Entusiasta en la definición de nuevos flujos de trabajo.

• Colaboración con creativos para alinear la performance del proyecto.

• Crear prototipos para mostrar ideas.

• Supervisar la optimización de gráficos.

BENEFICIOS:

– Incorporación a equipo joven y creativo, dinámico y lleno de ideas.

– Buen ambiente formado por científicos y artistas gráficos.

– Sector de clientes innovador y creativo : Biotecnología, Ciencia, Health y Life Sciences

– Formar parte del departamento I+D de la empresa

– Progresión de tu carrera profesional y salario en función de aptitudes y méritos

– Oficina en Madrid: Excelente localización y comunicación

– Retribución salarial acorde con la experiencia aportada.

– Posibilidad de trabajo en remoto.

3Dforscience

Sueldo: 2500€

Tags: Remoto

Empleo original

jobs_results.title: PROFESOR/LECTURER SECTOR VIDEOJUEGOS
jobs_results.company_name: ESAT - Escuela Superior de Arte y Tecnología
jobs_results.description:
OFERTA EMPLEO DOCENTE

ESAT (Escuela Superior de Arte y Tecnología), es una institución líder, con más de 18 años de

experiencia en la formación de profesionales altamente especializados en el desarrollo de

videojuegos. Reconocida como la Mejor Escuela en España de Desarrollo de Videojuegos,

cuarta en Europa y séptima a nivel mundial según GAMEducation 2023 (USA)

https://www.gameschools.com.

Como parte de su plan de mejora continua y crecimiento, está buscando profesionales para

incorporarse a su equipo de docentes, como Profesor en los programas Superiores de

Desarrollo de Videojuegos en el campus de Valencia (España).

Esta es una oportunidad única para formar parte de una institución galardonada

internacionalmente, y contribuir al desarrollo de la próxima generación de creadores de

videojuegos dentro de los altos estándares de excelencia que la definen.

Requisitos:
• Más de 5 años de experiencia y 3 al menos trabajando como senior en el desarrollo de

videojuegos. (Si... eres exalumno se pueden flexibilizar los requisitos)
• Sentir vocación por la docencia y por el trabajo en equipo.

Se valorará:

o Se valorará titulación académica de HND/Degree/Master en áreas relacionadas con el

desarrollo de videojuegos o disciplinas afines.

o Inglés fluido, se valorarán certificaciones como C1, IELTS 6.5 o superior o equivalente.

o Haber participado en títulos publicados triple A o indies de renombre.

o Buena predisposición al trabajo en equipo.

Funciones:

o Impartir clases teóricas y prácticas en el área de desarrollo de videojuegos.

o Guiar a los estudiantes en proyectos prácticos y en el desarrollo de sus habilidades

técnicas.

o Contribuir al diseño curricular y al desarrollo del programa académico.

Beneficios:

o Formar parte de un equipo dinámico y apasionado en un entorno de aprendizaje

innovador y en una empresa en plena expansión internacional.

o Oportunidades de crecimiento profesional y desarrollo continuo, ya que se facilita

compatibilizar la docencia con el trabajo en la industria (jornada flexible).

o Modalidad presencial y/o online.

o Salario muy competitivo acorde a la experiencia y habilidades del candidato.

Perfiles prioritarios de esta oferta:

● ENVIRONMENT ARTIST con conocimientos sólidos en Unreal Engine.

● ANIMADOR DE PERSONAJES 3D, deseable conocimiento de Unreal Engine.

● TECHNICAL ARTIST con conocimientos sólidos en Unreal Engine.

● DESARROLLADOR DE UX/UI con conocimientos sólidos en motores gráficos.

● LIGHTING.

● VISUAL FX.

● PROGRAMADOR motor gráfico (UNREAL/UNITY)

● DISEÑADOR senior de Videojuegos, en todas las modalidades.

Si cumples con los requisitos mencionados y estás interesado en unirte a nuestro equipo, envía

tu currículum vitae y una carta de presentación destacando tu experiencia y motivación para el

puesto a recruitment@esat.es.

¡Esperamos conocerte pronto y trabajar juntos para seguir elevando el estándar de excelencia

en la educación en desarrollo de videojuegos

jobs_results.title: Programador multiplataforma con Unity y Unreal
jobs_results.description:
Desarrollo de videojuegos multiplataforma por ampliación de equipo, somos un estudio de videojuegos indie. Si te interesa trabajar en un equipo comprometido, con una misión común, puede que esta sea la oferta de trabajo que estabas esperando. Necesitamos ampliar equipo con una persona que sea capaz de demostrar sus habilidades de programación y que sea comprometida con su trabajo. La oferta es para trabajar de manera presencial en el Polo de contenidos digitales de Málaga. Se pide experiencia previa demostrable. El contrato puede ser indefinido o a convenir según los intereses comunes. Se piden habilidades para comunicar y relacionarse con el equipo así como una persona capaz de tomar decisiones en su área de trabajo. Nos conmueve conocerte y poder trabajar unidos. Te estamos esperando. La misión la conocerás en las entrevistas. Gracias por tu tiempo.
Requisitos mínimos

Lenguajes de programación. C# C++
Programar el código del juego
Motor de juego: Renderizar los gráficos 2D y 3D... Simular las leyes de la física. Renderizar las animaciones y los sonidos. Encargarse de la Inteligencia Artificial
Capacidad de diseño y arte
Capacidad de narrativa
Desarrollar casos de prueba y poder ejecutar estos testeos para encontrar posibles errores en el desarrollo del videojuego.
Requisitos deseados

Lenguajes de programación. C# C++
Programar el código del juego
Motor de juego: Renderizar los gráficos 2D y 3D. Simular las leyes de la física. Renderizar las animaciones y los sonidos. Encargarse de la Inteligencia Artificial
Capacidad de diseño y arte
Capacidad de narrativa
Desarrollar casos de prueba y poder ejecutar estos testeos para encontrar posibles errores en el desarrollo del videojuego.
Responsabilidades

Responsabilidad con los tiempos de entrega.
Beneficios

Oficina, dispositivos que se necesitan para el trabajo, contrato de trabajo, equipo unido, adaptación de los horarios, remuneración como CTO

jobs_results.title: Senior Game Artist
jobs_results.description:
About FunPlus Barcelona

FunPlus is a global creator of interactive entertainment experiences powered by technology, with cross-platform game development and IP creation at its core. Founded in 2010, FunPlus is an organization that fosters top industry talent globally, with offices in over 10 cities and 6 countries, and more than 2,000 team members worldwide. FunPlus is home to talented creative teams who are well-known for developing hugely popular mobile strategy titles including State of Survival, King of Averlon and Guns of Glory.

In Barcelona, FunPlus has a dynamic, engaging and growing publishing office along with a new development studio. Both offices are searching for top talent who are looking for an entrepreneurial environment backed by one of the most successfull gaming companies in the world. So say YES to a new adventure!

Your role

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Game Artist to join our team at our new video game studio. You will be responsible... for creating high-quality, visually stunning assets for our casual mobile games in Unity.

We are looking for a creative artist that enjoys working in small teams to craft new ideas and develop new games from scratch, being able to cover all the artistic needs of projects.

In this role, you should have a strong understanding of game art principles and be able to apply them to create immersive and visually appealing game experiences. You should also be able to work efficiently and meet tight deadlines.

To be successful in this role, you should have a strong portfolio of game art work, including experience creating assets for casual games on mobile devices and implementation in Unity. You should also have excellent communication skills and be able to work well in a team environment.

Your Responsibilities
• Build next generation casual games for mobile using Unity from concept to launch.
• Create illustrations, concepts and final high-quality game assets for mobile casual games.
• Implement and integrate game assets into the game using Unity.
• Always look for a hit, even if that implies regularly killing prototypes.
• Create 2D art from concept sketching to final renderings/tweaks.
• Have a passion for games and a good understanding of what makes a game visually appealing.
• Stay up-to-date with industry trends and techniques, and continually improve your skills and knowledge of game art and development.
• Collaborate with the game design and development team to ensure that all assets meet the required standards and fit the overall vision of the game.
• Participate in game design and provide feedback and ideas for new games.
• Have a startup mentality and want to foster a similar environment.

Your profile
• A strong portfolio showcasing your generalist game art skills and experience in casual style.
• Experience as a game artist on a released mobile title.
• Proficiency with a variety of software tools such as Maya/Blender, Photoshop, and ZBrush.
• Experience with Unity and the ability to implement and integrate game assets into the game engine.
• Strong understanding of game development principles and best practices.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work well in a team environment.
• Passionate about building new and innovative games from scratch.
• A degree in game art, graphic design, or a related field is preferred but not required.

Perks of your new adventure
• Flexible working hours - We know you have other quests and fun activities in your life, as long as you get your job done, flex away.
• Excellent benefits - Restaurant vouchers, health insurance for you and your family, gym and exercise credits, and more…
• Multicultural teams - With so many offices worldwide, you will have opportunities to engage and learn from your global colleagues.
• Diverse team events - Barcelona has the reputation of fun, and this office is determined to keep up that reputation.
• International and expert leadership - You can’t create legends without legendary leadership.
• Creative environment - This is entertainment after all folks!
• And we are dog-friendly!

FunPlus is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace

jobs_results.title: Programador Unity
jobs_results.description:
Virtual Zone es una empresa que ofrece en sus locales experiencias de VR creadas por su
propio estudio de desarrollo. Actualmente cuenta con 5 locales abiertos, Alicante, Madrid, Valencia, Murcia y Sevilla. Las experiencias que se crean en Virtual Zone son las más grandes de Europa en su modalidad LB (Local Based).

La oficina de desarrollo de Virtual Zone busca a un/a programador/a que cuente con algo de experiencia en el mundo de los videojuegos para incorporar a nuestra plantilla de forma inmediata con jornada completa.

Actualmente estamos con la preproducción de un nuevo proyecto y necesitamos a una persona con conocimientos en programación y entornos multijugador. Requisitos mínimos

? Título formativo relacionado con los videojuegos y/o el mundo de la informática y programación.
? Experiencia demostrable en Unity.
? Conocimientos en C# y PPO.
? Conocimiento en compilación en Windows.
? Capacidad de trabajar en equipo y estar en constante comunicación.
? Capacidad para recibir... tareas e instrucciones y ser capaz de cuestionarlas con criterio.
? Capacidad de detectar, analizar, resolver problemas y ser autocrítico.
? Portfolio con demos.
? Puesto presencial en estudio de desarrollo en Alicante (no teletrabajo).
Requisitos deseados

? Conocimientos demostrables en Photon/Fusion u otra API de sistema multijugador.
? Conocimientos en otros lenguajes de programación.
? Conocimientos en bases de datos.
? Conocimientos en JSON.
? Conocimientos de Android/iOS en Unity.
? Conocimientos en Hardware.
? Conocimientos en VR, AR.
? Conocimientos en repositorios (Git ,Plastic SMC).
Responsabilidades

? Participar en el desarrollo del entorno multijugador.
? Creación de herramientas durante el desarrollo del proyecto.
? Asistir en la creación de la IA del proyecto.
? Desarrollar e implementar código lógico y reutilizable.
? Asegurarse de que el diseño del juego esté completamente implementado y funcione como se espera.
? Creación de pruebas y procedimientos de validación y documentación de todas las especificaciones técnicas.
? Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con el game designer para ir avanzando en todas las fases del desarrollo de un juego.
? Seleccionar frameworks adecuados y traducir conceptos en código limpio y eficiente.
? Diseñar y probar funciones de juego y prototipos.
? Documentar el ciclo de vida completo del desarrollo de juegos.
? Mantener el código, resolver problemas y realizar correcciones de errores.
? Integrar las últimas tendencias de la industria de los juegos en los diseños de juegos.
Beneficios

? Horario de entrada flexible.
? Ambiente de trabajo cercano, joven y divertido.
? Comedor, zona chill y zona de juegos

jobs_results.title: Gameplay Programmers (Multiple)
jobs_results.description:
IO Interactive is currently looking for multiple Gameplay Programmers to join Project 007, a brand-new James Bond video game to be developed and published by IOI. Featuring a wholly original Bond story, players will step into the shoes of the world's favorite Secret Agent to earn their 00 status in the very first James Bond origin story.

The positions are open in our Brighton, Barcelona, Malmö and Istanbul offices where we offer a hybrid setup working 2 days from home and 3 days in our studios.

For the right candidates, we will offer relocation support and welcome you to any of the locations.

What you will do:
• As a Gameplay Programmer, you'll work across multiple areas within the core gameplay domain: characters, cameras, control scheme, weapons and items, abilities and progression, environments, and interactions, to name a few.
• You'll be responsible for designing, owning, and maintaining systems and code across some of those areas, but also have the chance to contribute with... designs and reviews in other areas and have a general overview of the whole domain.
• You'll work primarily in C++, creating code, systems, and visual building blocks for our designers to use in Glacier, our in-house technology, via our integrated Visual Scripting Language.
• As a part of a game team, you will collaborate with other programmers, designers, and content creators, to build and enrich the game
• You will collaborate creatively with the other gameplay programmers and create engaging gameplay for our future players.

Who you are:
• You have 2+ years of professional gameplay programming experience, on a AAA title.
• Open-minded and willing to accept and provide feedback to ensure the highest quality for our systems and gameplay features.
• You have hands-on experience with gameplay features implementation, such as systems, characters, cameras, control schemes, weapons, gadgets, abilities, progression, and interactions.
• You will work day-to-day in C++, so we expect you to have a strong foundation and understanding of the best practices.

Who we are:

IO Interactive is an independent videogame development and publishing company with studios in Copenhagen, Malmö, and Barcelona. As the creative force behind some of the most talked-about multiplatform video games in the last decade, we are committed to creating unforgettable characters and experiences – all powered by our award-winning, proprietary Glacier technology.

We know that to achieve those goals, we need courage, talented people and a great working environment – and we do our utmost to have all of that. Across our multiple studios, we’re working on several projects. Crucially though, we’re all one team. We value the work and impact that each person brings to the table and we actively encourage new ideas, whilst listening to your insights along the way.

We have a dedicated team of People Managers, who look after you as an individual and as an employee. With more than 40 nationalities, we know that everyone is different and we are proud to have a reputation for being a friendly workplace with highly-talent people.

Learn more about Project 007

jobs_results.title: Senior Game Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs_results.description:
Klang is a game studio exploring the future of humanity through various forms of media. We aim to present deep, meaningful subjects in a way that's captivating, easy-to-digest and entertaining for all ages.

At the heart of Klang is Seed, a large-scale, persistent virtual world that we believe will redefine the MMO landscape and have a positive impact on our species.

We aspire to bring people together through engaging media experiences and by building strong communities.

It's a super exciting project, but in order for us to achieve a goal like this we are going to need a lot of help! From people just like you.

About the position

Klang is looking for a Senior Game Engineer (f/m/d) who enjoys a collaborative and creative work environment to join us in one of the most exciting cities on the planet!

What you will do
• Work in one of several interdisciplinary and diverse teams of designers, engineers, and quality assurance
• Collaborate to design, prototype, and implement new game... systems
• Develop game features through every step of the development process, from initial design all the way to live game support
• Identify technical and developmental bottlenecks and generate solutions to overcome identified risks
• Provide input on the technical direction for an ambitious MMO project, built on excellent technical foundations
• Build and maintain great documentation

Who we think will be a great fit
• You have 5 or more years of in-depth experience with Unity and C# programming
• You shipped two or more commercial titles for PC or Consoles
• You would like to specialize in at least one of these: Gameplay, Client-Server, or Rendering & Shaders
• You have experience working in an Agile development environment
• You communicate exceptionally well within an interdisciplinary team in an open and honest environment
• You are confident in your work and care about the quality of what you produce
• You are able to communicate fluently in English
• You are curious, always eager to learn new things- and to teach them back to the team!

Bonus
• Successfully experienced the full life cycle of multiplayer game development, from concept to release
• Experience in working with multiplayer networked games
• A fan of large scale MMOs, life, ecology or economy simulations

Benefits
• An opportunity to work on a groundbreaking project with a lot of room for professional and personal development
• Competitive salary and 27 days of paid vacation
• Monthly public transport travel reimbursement
• Monthly company co-contributions to private pensions
• Reimbursement for physical health activities
• Employee Assistance Program
• Mental health support
• Flexible office hours (with core hours)
• Monthly team events and activities
• A dog-friendly office, adjustable standing desks, ergonomic chairs and mobile aircon units for hot summers
• Healthy snacks and drinks in the office

If you don't feel that you quite meet all the requirements above, but the position still excites you and you think you would love to work for Klang, reach out! We still want to hear from you.

At Klang, we create products that inspire people to deepen their understanding of the emergent nature of society and collectively envision a better future.

At the heart of Klang is SEED an accessible, persistent world in which players share a history and shape a future. We provide an environment for a broad audience to belong and develop relationships in a society simulation inspired by life itself.

We explicitly encourage applications from applicants from groups underrepresented in games/tech spaces. We value all kinds of backgrounds and walks of life
